responsibility: Implementation of function-level RTL SSA construction and simplification. This file builds a function_info object from a GCC function, initializes SSA storage, constructs blocks and instructions, simplifies phi nodes by propagating equivalent values and modes, and provides function-level printing and dumping entry points.
same_name_distinction: Provides the top-level executable behavior of function_info declared in functions.h, especially whole-function SSA construction startup, block processing orchestration, phi simplification, and function dumping; unlike functions.h, it is the implementation of building and simplifying function-wide RTL SSA state.
